title: Serve every command as an MCP tool, read-only unless --allow says more
notes: All reading commands, the writing ones with --allow write and the whole-backlog ones with --allow admin; each with repository and, for a change, preview.
result: tadu mcp serves the reading tools by default and the writing (--allow write) or whole-backlog ones (--allow admin); every tool takes repository, a change preview
evidence: pytest: 1363 tests at 100% coverage, ruff, mypy --strict and codeality clean; tests/test_run_mcp.py lists 10, 15 and 20 tools by level; tests/test_mcp_call.py marks and claims a task over MCP
